content: The true temple is built without bricks or mortar; its pillars are truth, its roof is love, its altar is peace.
author: Kabir
explanation: When you empty yourself of personal vanity, self-will, and stubborn opinions, you become a transparent channel through which universal intelligence creates beauty.
practicalInsight: Empty your mind of preconceptions before your next project. Allow creativity to flow through without forcing.
reflectionPrompt: What rigid opinion must I empty out so higher wisdom can play through me?
